Failed development criteria: `section7_regime_frequencies_inside_90pct_predictive_bands`.

## Findings

* The section-7 mechanism check fails: 2020 had 49 PARTIAL games against a 90% predictive band of 19-40 from 2018-2019, so the regime model fitted on the development seasons did not describe the development hold-out season. This alone makes Q1 REJECTED_AT_DEVELOPMENT; the rule is applied as written.
* Ambiguity (recorded, not resolved in Q1's favour): PREREGISTRATION section 3 names the lower-decile check as the mechanism check and section 7 names the regime-frequency check; both are required here because relaxing either after seeing 2020 would be choosing the gate from the outcome.
* The lower-decile check itself passes: P(rPIT < 0.10) for attempts moves 0.152 -> 0.095, completions 0.151 -> 0.100, passing yards 0.136 -> 0.097, with CRPS better; but the 2020 primary interval includes zero (-0.0432 [-0.0595, +0.0026]).
* Negative: the mean overshoots. Attempts bias moves +1.19 -> -0.60 and MAE worsens +1.17% (passing yards +0.93%): an unconditional exit mixture moves mass from every starter, not from the ones who will leave.
* Diagnostic 2025 is the one season where the primary is worse (+0.0117); 2025 is the season with daily depth charts, where the incumbent identified the starter best.
* A conditional (feature-based) regime model did not beat the unconditional frequencies on 2020 log loss; the fixed feature list does not identify exits in advance at this sample size.
